correctness.rationale: For the exact stationary two-state environment and off-diagonal two-stage matrices, multiplication over even times yields the exact sum c S_N+log(x1 exp(d D_N)+x2 exp(-d D_N)); the log-sum term differs from |d D_N| uniformly by a fixed constant for positive initial cohorts. Bounded martingale differences yield a joint diagonal two-dimensional CLT for S_N and D_N, with uniform fourth moments securing convergence of means and variances. Positive centered third moment of the folded-normal term proves nonnormality; strict convexity of c^2/t+(1-2/pi)d^2 t gives the unique optimizer and exact boundary cases. The bundled standalone verifier checks the finite product identities, exact Markov second moments and numerical convergence, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Semelparous zero-retention stage structure is a biologically natural boundary of standard primitive-population lognormal theory. The exact joint limit finds an intrinsically nonnormal log-abundance uncertainty distribution even when the almost-sure exponential growth rate is independent of environment autocorrelation, and it provides both the sharp mean-square-root-time effect and a unique explicit variance-minimizing switching probability. This informs the mathematical interpretation of population risk under correlated environmental forcing. A mere alternate parameterization or small numerical improvement cannot account for this combination; the statement holds across a full continuous parameter family.
